title: EU leaders put forward Pablo Hernández de Cos to lead the ECB
seoTitle: Pablo Hernández de Cos: what’s next for the ECB nomination
dek: The former governor of Spain’s central bank is the choice to succeed Christine Lagarde at the European Central Bank. The formal appointment process is still underway.
happened: European leaders backed Pablo Hernández de Cos at their November 26 meeting in Brussels. He runs the Bank for International Settlements and previously served on the ECB’s rate-setting Governing Council as governor of the Bank of Spain. EU leaders also put forward Laurence Boone and Markus Brunnermeier for seats on the ECB’s Executive Board.

sides.says: The European Council put Hernández de Cos forward as part of a package of three nominations for the ECB’s Executive Board.
Reuters reported that the Netherlands backed Hernández de Cos on Thursday, clearing the way for agreement after Dutch former central bank chief Klaas Knot had been a contender.

next: The European Parliament and the ECB’s Governing Council are consulted before the European Council makes the formal appointment. If confirmed, Hernández de Cos is expected to succeed Lagarde when she leaves on February 7, 2027.
summary: EU leaders selected Pablo Hernández de Cos as their candidate to succeed Christine Lagarde. The nomination still goes through consultations before the formal appointment.
